scenes.headline: How Qwen3.8-Flash-Next remembers cheaply and retrieves precisely
scenes.sub: 125B backbone, 51B of N-gram embeddings, 6B active per token.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Squiggle! Qwen3.8-Flash-Next has a hundred and twenty-five billion parameters and a fifty-one-billion lookup table. Six billion work per token.

scenes.text: Four changes to the Transformer, in attention, residual, embedding and optimiser, each chosen by its own controlled experiment.
scenes.say: Four changes: attention, residual, embedding and optimiser. Each one chosen by its own controlled experiment.

steps.say: A token climbs forty-eight layers: three Gated DeltaNet, then one sparse attention, twelve times over. Every layer also picks ten of five hundred and twelve experts.

steps.note: a fixed-size state, not a growing cache
steps.say: DeltaNet keeps a fixed-size state, not a growing cache. It writes back only the error for each key: erase and rewrite, not append.
But a finite state can't retrieve exactly, so every fourth layer attends globally.
At layer two, a fifty-one-billion N-gram table joins in. Its lookups are known in advance, so they're prefetched from host memory.

scenes.title: Qwen Sparse Attention: the selector is the cost

steps.label: The indexer scans every token
steps.say: Sparse attention reads a fixed number of tokens, but its indexer still scans them all. At a million tokens, choosing costs more than reading.

steps.label: Micro-blocks: the scan shrinks fourfold
steps.say: Qwen Sparse Attention compresses first, into micro-blocks, so that scan shrinks fourfold.

steps.label: Attend to the chosen blocks
steps.say: It keeps the most relevant blocks, and attends only to those.

scenes.title: Gated Residual: four lanes instead of one

left.title: One residual stream
items: Every layer reads and writes the same stream
Early features diluted by later writes
left.say: Normally every layer writes into one residual stream, and early features get diluted.

right.title: Four gated lanes
items: Reads and writes pass through gates
One lane became a long-range pathway
right.say: Gated Residual widens it to four lanes with gated reads and writes. One lane became a long-range path nobody designed.

scenes.title: Residual ladder, benchmark points gained
scenes.note: by training loss, the gates added only 0.002
scenes.say: By training loss, the data-dependent gates looked like noise. By benchmark average, they beat the widening: one point nine eight points to one point five eight.

scenes.text: The metric you can watch and the metric you want can diverge. This report says where, and which one it followed.
scenes.say: The metric you can watch and the metric you want can diverge. This report says where.

recap: Three DeltaNet layers, then one sparse attention
A 51B N-gram table prefetched from host memory
scenes.say: To recap: DeltaNet with sparse attention, four gated lanes, and a lookup table that lives off the GPU.
